sections.heading: Section 1 - Introducing the Just in Time Context Loop

bone_collections.name: Cognitive Architecture & Hippocampus Model
bone_collections.description: Hippocampus vector retrieval connected to LLM prefrontal cortex.

paragraphs.text: Human introduction and ideas: JITC - make it obvious that Section 1 is my side of the collaboration. History: Large context models brute force, RAG, ICM and claude-mem are passive, grep is brittle.

“What I have is almost a blog. A collection of ideas that I noticed actually started to work. But measuring is hard. How do I describe a cognitive jump? It's more like a strategy guide that worked really well, applied on several levels, and connecting it to a loop allows me to have complex conversations about things only cloud models could talk about. I guess the idea is that cloud models are good like savants with huge memory, but all we need is to design a hippocampus and connect it to a prefontal cortex. What I have are practical notes on building that.
LLM’s are a prefrontal cortex, cloud models depend on massive short term memory but we don’t need that what we need is to design a Hippocampus and connect it properly, RAG get’s us half way thare.
Define Intuition as a retrieval problem: unsolicited ideas that bubble up relations and connections. Knowledge -> tagging -> wisdom -> hook/trigger -> intuitive behavior

Supporting concepts: Like a Last mile math proof - call out unique ideas that connect the dots. Saving memories -> dreaming (distillation) -> Pearls. Gems (Pearls) of Wisdom - feats, gems, BKM, DNA. Tagging Pearls - contextual triggers, comments in code. Tagging: the critical connection. Comments in code serve as flags to references. Automatic indexes. Bringing intuition to the outside world beyond coding would need something similar - something to pop up critical context just in time. Refinement: Refine pearls rather than duplicate ideas. Provide a flow to Blend new ideas together. Providing flows - back pressure feedback loops. Building up complex flows with pearls as building blocks - gives bones to give structure and coherence. JITC is ambient, just in time, and just the relevant information at the right time. Concepts are pre compiled - needs nightly refinement and consolidation. JITC Cycle (Graphic): Describe the JITC Cycle: triage, fingertip context, collection, distillation, classification.
